reproduction: Read reports/market/demo_snapshots/*.json and compare evidence_reference_ids across companies
observed: All 26 snapshots carry count=474 and the same first 64 evidence ids; Johnson & Johnson cites Cloudflare's sources

reproduction: HSB.bind(store.evidence()) then inspect each posterior distribution
observed: hidden_state_refs published 'GROWING' for 22 companies; every posterior is uniform over 12 postures at 0.0833, entropy 3.585 = log2(12)
expected: A posture is published only when the engine has distinguished it from the prior
decision_impact: A CEO reads 'the system infers this company is GROWING' when the system inferred nothing. Fabricated finding.
root_cause: leading returns the first key of a tied distribution; nothing tested whether the posterior carried information
fix: _posture_identified requires the leader to be strictly ahead of the runner-up and of the uniform baseline; unidentified states publish as a measured zero naming the reason
break_proof_if_required: CAUGHT (a uniform posterior is published as an identified posture) plus negative control (the uniformity guard swallows a real weak lead)
retest: Live: 0 fabricated postures; 22 report 'tracked and none identified: the posterior is uniform'
